visualize_coarse_segmentation: create a DensePoseDataCoarseSegmentationVisualizer to overlay ground truth segmentation masks on an image with configurable colormap and alpha
visualize_densepose_points: build a DensePoseDataPointsVisualizer to draw keypoints on an image using bounding boxes and DensePoseDataRelative data
visualize_u_coordinates: create a DensePoseDataPointsUVisualizer to visualize U texture coordinates as colored points on an image
visualize_v_coordinates: build a DensePoseDataPointsVVisualizer to visualize V texture coordinates as colored points on an image
visualize_body_part_indices: create a DensePoseDataPointsIVisualizer to visualize body part index labels as colored points on an image
